items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The second week was with a quintet with me, Miles, John Lewis, Al McKibbon, and Max.

ctx.x: Well Kenny Clarke and Max Roach, basically. Different trombone players. I don’t remember it well. I don’t even remember Gunther Schuller playing on the band.
I think he was just on the last recording session, the nineteen fifty-one?
